# Deccan Chronicle

> > Deccan Chronicle is a leading English-language news platform delivering breaking news, regional coverage from southern Indian states, and comprehensive national and international reporting.

Deccan Chronicle serves as a primary news source for India with particular strength in coverage of Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka. The platform provides real-time breaking news, political coverage, sports updates, entertainment reporting, and specialized coverage of regional elections and state-level developments.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Southern States
- Telangana
- Andhra Pradesh
- Tamil Nadu
- Karnataka
- Kerala
- Regional Politics
- Election Coverage
- Cricket & IPL
- Bollywood & Entertainment
- National News
- International News
- Sports News
- Assembly Elections 2026

## Breaking News & Homepage

- [Deccan Chronicle Homepage](https://www.deccanchronicle.com): Main homepage with breaking news from Hyderabad, politics, entertainment, sports, business, and technology
- [Just In - Latest Breaking News](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/just-in): Real-time breaking news feed for India with focus on southern states coverage

## Regional News - Southern States

- [Southern States Hub](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/location/india/southern-states): Regional news aggregating coverage from Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka
- [Telangana News](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/location/india/telangana): Telangana regional news with politics, budget, agriculture, and local government coverage
- [Andhra Pradesh News](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/location/india/andhra-pradesh): Andhra Pradesh state news with local politics and municipal administration
- [Tamil Nadu News](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/location/india/tamil-nadu): Tamil Nadu state news covering DMK-AIADMK politics and regional elections
- [Karnataka News](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/location/india/karnataka): Karnataka regional politics with BJP-Congress coverage and assembly bypoll elections
- [Kerala News](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/location/india/kerala): Kerala state news covering assembly elections and political campaigns

## National & International News

- [India National News](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/nation): National news from India covering Congress, NCP, and breaking political developments
- [World News](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/world): International news covering NATO, Iraq, Iran, Canada, and global geopolitical events

## Sports Coverage

- [Sports News Hub](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/sports): Sports news hub covering cricket, IPL 2026, football, and Indian sports coverage
- [Cricket News & Live Scores](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/sports/cricket): Cricket news with live scores, IPL coverage, WPL updates, and tournament results
- [Football News](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/sports/football): Football news covering FIFA, international matches, and women's football updates
- [Tennis News](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/sports/tennis): Tennis news with scores, results, Indian Wells, ATP rankings, and tournament coverage
- [Other Sports](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/sports/other-sports): Mixed sports coverage including MMA, boxing, chess, women's sports, and Olympics

## Entertainment & Lifestyle

- [Entertainment News](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/entertainment): Entertainment news covering Bollywood, Hollywood, Tollywood, regional cinema, and celebrity gossip

## Special Coverage & Analysis

- [Assembly Elections 2026](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/assembly-elections-2026): Coverage of 2026 assembly elections across Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Tamil Nadu
- [Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/corporate-insolvency-resolution-process): News coverage of Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) and corporate bankruptcy in India
- [NRI News](https://www.deccanchronicle.com/nri): NRI news covering Indians abroad, crime, legal cases, immigration, and visa issues
